svg.aria-label: Two stories take turns. First a repository page where four places light up one at a time: the title, the first lines, the image alt text and the topics. Then a web page at example.com where the page title, the meta description, the headings and the link preview light up in turn. A card names each place and the phrase that goes there; the rest of the text stays grey and untouched.
svg.text: Only the places search engines read
One phrase per place. The rest of your text stays as you wrote it.
